subject: The secret 87 users discovered today
preview_text: They found something in their conversations that changed everything. You might have missed it.
body_paragraphs: I just checked the dashboard and had to sit down for a second. 87 people used the scanner today and found the exact same pattern. A pattern so subtle, most people miss it until it's too late. It's the kind of thing that makes you go, 'Oh. That's why I felt that way.'

Every single one of those scans picked up on a specific form of emotional manipulation hidden in casual texts. Not the obvious insults, but the quiet, 'I'm just joking' digs that slowly erode your confidence. The data doesn't lie. While you were busy today, 87 people got a clarity they didn't have yesterday. They're not guessing anymore. They have proof.

This is exactly what the Pattern Detection feature is for. It doesn't just look at one message. It connects the dots across your entire conversation history. It shows you the frequency, the escalation, the hidden script you've been following without realizing it. It turns your gut feeling into a highlighted report.

Open the app. Don't just scan one message. Tap 'View Patterns' on your dashboard. See what story your conversations are really telling. It takes 60 seconds. P.S. The most common reaction we see after someone checks their patterns? 'I knew it. I just needed to see it.'
